closedThisRound.detail: ARM9 0x02060BF0 indexes a table at 0x0209F7C4 by slot number; entries 16,15,14,13,12,11,10,9 resolve to toolbar.nxr node indices, where node 16 is button0 and node 9 is button7. Slot N is buttonN, left to right. The descending table is an index inversion, not a reordering of the row.

Every slot carries a submenu of up to eight entries. Pointer table at toolbar+0xE64 (8 slots x 8 x 4, slot stride 0x20); per-slot count array at +0xF64. The pointer table begins exactly where the slot array ends (0x64 + 8*0x1C0 = 0xE64), corroborating both offsets. The submenu is not a property of one special slot.

Storage proven; population site not found. ARM9 only ever clears the counts to zero (0x02060770, 0x02060C70). Hunt and Battle remain ROM_VERIFIED members of a submenu from tutorial text alone.
slot+0x192 and slot+0xBE are both initialised to 0 and are candidates; nothing proves either is an enable flag.
